tasks.title: Modify PROMPT.md
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md. Use selected architecture and the current project layout. FR-001.
Prior review and diagnosis remain in .gwrk/review-history/phase-01-through-2026-11-18T2242Z.json and findings.jsonl. Both byte-identical code review prompts include Principal Engineer guidance and project verification commands. Python, unknown and native captured dispatches exercise both workflows. Source and built prompt parity checks are required by the phase gate. All 194 phase checks and 2241 full-suite tests pass. Independent clearance remains required.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Host architecture document overrides configured toolchain — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/engine/profile-detector.ts:233-241,437-476
  EXPECTED: With docs/architecture.md and project.type=python in .gwrkrc.json, dispatch uses Python and python-standards without GWRK paths or pnpm commands.
  ACTUAL: With no language manifest, the detector returns gwrk-native and TypeScript. gwrk-specify emits docs/grounding/architecture.md and specs/000-build-plan.md.
  FIX: Resolve explicit host settings before the document fallback. Require project identity for GWRK-only guidance. Add TR-012 dry-run cases for all four workflows with docs/architecture.md and no language manifest.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/engine/profile-detector.ts — Preserve `@gwrk/cli` self-detection via `_isGwrk`. Remove the `docs/architecture.md` fallback and the `gwrk-native` override bypass. In `readLocalProject`, default `stack.language` to `Python` for `project.type: "python"` when config omits the language. Update the document-only fixtures in `src/engine/profile-detector.test.ts` to expect `unknown` and preserve the root-design assertion.
FIX: src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts — Add TR-012 dry runs for `gwrk-specify` and `gwrk-plan` with `docs/architecture.md`, `.gwrkrc.json` declaring `project.type: "python"`, and no language manifest. Use `captureDispatch(workflow)` without a profile mock. Assert `language="Python"`, `python-standards`, and host guidance. Reject `docs/grounding/architecture.md`, `specs/000-build-plan.md`, `pnpm` verification commands, `typescript-standards`, and `gwrk-conventions`.
FIX: src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts — Add the same TR-012 fixture for `review-code-cli` and `review-code-webapp`. Assert Python enforcement and `hostReviewGuidance`, and reject matches for `nativeReviewCommandPattern`. Record all four cases in `specs/045-workflow-governance/plan.md`. Run the existing `specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-01.sh` before the detector change to observe the failures and again after the fix to verify they pass.
